name: Samuhik Kanya Vivah Sahayata Yojana (UKBOCWWB)
benefit: - ₹61,000/- will be provided as financial assistance to registered construction workers for the marriage of their daughters. - ₹10,000/- per couple will be paid to the organizer to cover expenses incurred in organizing the mass marriage. - ₹5,000/- will be provided to each bride and groom for purchasing their wedding attire.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a registered construction worker. 1. In the case of a mass marriage, registration must be completed at least 15 days prior to the scheduled date of the marriage.
